title: Tenma Saki — Magic Show Assistant!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Seaside School - 1 week prior
School SEKAI
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That was great...!
We were really in sync just now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. This is a good place to stop too, so why don't we call it a day.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku, thanks again for your help.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
When's our next practice going to be?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Tomorrow, of course!
Right, Shiho♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure. But practicing every day like this is going to be hard next week.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. That's already next week...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is there something going on next week?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! Hehe. Next week...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're going to the Seaside School♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The Seaside School? What's that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's a school tradition that's meant to give girls in the same year to get to know each other a little better.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We all get to stay in this seaside lodge, go swimming, make curry together and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: On the last day, we're supposed to put on a show where each of our groups are gonna do some kind of performance.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds like a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I missed out on all the overnight school events during junior high, so this is sort of a first for me. I'm sooo excited to go♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm excited too. I've really been looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You have? I feel like which groups we get assigned to is gonna have a huge effect on what happens...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It'd be so awkward if we get stuck with someone we know nothing about.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, that's the whole point! We're supposed to meet new people and make new friends!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. More specifically, it's supposed to foster a sense of camaraderie and community...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: To Saki, that probably means the exact same thing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, has anyone started to pack yet?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I have!
I've got sunscreen, towels and... Oh, it wasn't in the handbook, but bug spray just in case!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We also need to bring enough money for souvenirs and snacks to eat in our room at the lodge!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Snacks too? Are you sure that you won't be bringing too much?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh! I have that covered! I just need to take them out of their boxes and put them into their own baggies!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You really want to bring them along, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, do you know what we're supposed to do about shampoo and soap?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure they'll have some ready for us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we'll probably have to bring our own toothbrush, toothpaste and stuff like that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I totally forgot about those!
Thanks for the reminder, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, also... The seniors in the Cleanup Committee said that we should take a sweater or a jacket with us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Apparently, it still gets cold at night because it's right on the beach.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really? But the sea breeze sounds so nice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it does. But I think I'll take something just in case. I'd hate to catch a cold while we're there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks for the tip, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, don't thank me. Thank the seniors from the Cleanup Committee.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot. They also recommended that we bring separate beach and bath towels.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The school has laundry machines on-site, but the seniors said that the dryer was out of order when they went.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yikes... So they had to dry off using the towels they just used at the beach...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds awful...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. It probably is a good idea to take two separate towels then.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I believe that just leaves our swimsuits...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! Wow, I can't even remember the last time I went swimming...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Maybe not since...
Elementary school...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, that means the last time I swam was in one of those really shallow kiddie pools!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you might be right. I also remember how you weren't always allowed to go in the water.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And you'll be swimming in the ocean, right? Won't the water be too choppy for you, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I... I really don't know...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There will be waves, but I doubt we'll be doing any long-distance swimming. I'm sure you'll be okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree. You can always have someone in your group teach you how to swim too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I really don't want to be a bother to anyone, but I guess I'll just have to ask...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Have your groups not been decided yet?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, they're having a random draw tomorrow, so we'll find out then!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wonder who's going to be in my group. I hope we get to have lots of fun together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure they will since they'll have you there with them, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to hearing all about it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We'll talk lots when we get back!
